clacton.name: Clacton-on-Sea
clacton.tag: End of the Sunshine Coast line
clacton.lead: Right at the end of the Sunshine Coast line, so you can’t miss your stop.
clacton.walk: From the station it’s about 10 to 15 minutes on foot. Head down through the town centre to the seafront, then turn right for the West Greensward.
clacton.back: Allow about 15 minutes to walk back up to the station from the West Greensward, and a bit more when the crowds leave.
clacton.facNote: When I last checked, in November 2026. Lifts and toilets can be out of order, so check on the day.

ayr.name: Ayr
ayr.lead: The end of the line for most trains from Glasgow Central.
ayr.walk: From the station it’s about 15 to 20 minutes on foot. Walk down Fort Street and through Wellington Square to the Esplanade, and the Low Green is right in front of you. On show days the streets are busy, so you can just follow the crowd.
ayr.back: Allow about 20 minutes to walk back up to the station from the Low Green, and a bit more when the crowds leave, especially after the Friday evening show.
ayr.facNote: When I last checked, in November 2026. Lifts and toilets can be out of order, so check on the day.

blackpool.name: Blackpool North
blackpool.lead: The main station in town, at the top end of Talbot Road.
rows: About four trains an hour from Preston
blackpool.walk: I would walk down Talbot Road to Talbot Square and North Pier, then south along the promenade to the Tower. Allow 15 minutes, or a bit more in the crowds.
blackpool.back: Head back up Talbot Road from Talbot Square to the station, about 15 minutes. After the last display the station fills quickly, so allow a bit longer.
blackpool.facNote: When I last checked, in November 2026. Lifts and toilets can be out of order, so check on the day.

cosford.name: Cosford
cosford.lead: A small station right beside RAF Cosford. On show day it gets very busy.
cosford.walk: Cosford station sits right next to the airfield, so it’s only about 300 metres to the show. On show day there are staff and signs, and honestly you can just follow everyone else. There is no step free access to the platforms, so if you use a wheelchair or struggle with steps, please take a look at the show’s accessibility page before you book.
cosford.back: Allow about 10 minutes to walk back to the station, and a lot longer when the flying finishes, as there’s a queue system at the station when it gets busy.
cosford.facNote: When I last checked, in November 2026. Lifts and toilets can be out of order, so check on the day.

duxford.name: Cambridge
duxford.tag: Free Air Show shuttle from here
duxford.lead: Get off here and pick up the free shuttle bus to IWM Duxford.
rows: Several trains an hour from London
duxford.walk: Head out of the station to the bus interchange on Station Place and find stand 5. The free Air Show shuttle runs from there to IWM Duxford and takes about 30 minutes, with no need to book.
duxford.back: The shuttle drops you back at Cambridge station. In 2026 the buses back ran every 30 minutes from 15:30, with the last at 18:30.
duxford.facNote: When I last checked, in November 2026. Lifts and toilets can be out of order, so check on the day.

eastbourne.name: Eastbourne
eastbourne.tag: End of the line from London
eastbourne.lead: The end of the line, right in the middle of town.
rows: Every 30 minutes from London, hourly on Sundays
eastbourne.walk: From the station it’s about 10 to 15 minutes on foot. Head down through the town centre to the seafront, then walk west along the prom to the Western Lawns by the Wish Tower. On show days there are plenty of stewards and signs, and you can just follow the crowd.
eastbourne.back: Allow about 15 minutes to walk back up to the station from the Western Lawns, and a bit more when the crowds leave.
eastbourne.facNote: When I last checked, in November 2026. Lifts and toilets can be out of order, so check on the day.

gransden.show: Little Gransden Air and Car Show
gransden.name: St Neots
gransden.tag: Taxi to the airfield from here
gransden.lead: The nearest station to Little Gransden, about 6 miles from the airfield.
gransden.walk: There’s no show shuttle from St Neots, so I would book a taxi before the day. The airfield is about 6 miles away and the taxi takes about 15 to 20 minutes. There’s no useful Sunday bus, and walking isn’t practical.
gransden.back: Rural taxis are limited on show days, so I would agree a pick up time with your taxi before the flying ends, and allow for traffic leaving the airfield.
gransden.facNote: When I last checked, in November 2026. Lifts and toilets can be out of order, so check on the day.

facilities.text: Step free, check the lifts are working

midlands.name: Redditch
midlands.tag: End of the Cross City line
midlands.lead: The end of the Cross City line from Birmingham, where you pick up the bus to Ragley Hall.
rows: Cross City line, about every 30 minutes
midlands.walk: From Redditch, the Diamond 247 bus to Evesham stops right by the Ragley Hall main entrance. In the current timetable there are only three buses each way on a Saturday and none on a Sunday or a bank holiday, so please check the bus times before you rely on it. From the main entrance it’s about 1.5 miles to the house, so wear comfortable shoes.
midlands.back: In the current timetable the last 247 bus back to Redditch passes Ragley at about 18:00, which is well before the evening balloons and the Nightfire. I would check the last bus before you go, then pick your train home from Redditch.
midlands.facNote: When I last checked, in November 2026. Lifts and toilets can be out of order, so check on the day.

southport.name: Southport
southport.tag: End of the line from Liverpool
southport.lead: The end of the Merseyrail line from Liverpool, a short walk from Lord Street.
southport.walk: From the station it’s about 10 to 15 minutes on foot. Head along Lord Street and Nevill Street towards the Promenade and Marine Drive. It’s flat all the way, and you’ll have plenty of other visitors walking with you.
southport.back: Allow about 15 minutes to walk back to the station from Marine Drive, and a bit more when everyone leaves at once after the flying.
southport.facNote: When I last checked, in November 2026. Lifts and toilets can be out of order, so check on the day.

wales.name: Swansea
wales.tag: End of the line from London
wales.lead: The main station in the city, at the top of the High Street.
rows: Most hours from London, more from Cardiff
wales.walk: From the station it’s about 20 to 25 minutes on foot. Head down through the city centre to Oystermouth Road and the promenade by the Civic Centre. Oystermouth Road and Mumbles Road are closed on show days, so it’s an easy walk once you’re through town, and you can just follow the crowd.
wales.back: Allow about 25 minutes to walk back up to the station from the seafront, and a fair bit longer when everyone leaves at once.
wales.facNote: When I last checked, in November 2026. Lifts and toilets can be out of order, so check on the day.

headcorn.name: Headcorn
headcorn.tag: Taxi or walk to the aerodrome
headcorn.lead: The nearest station to Headcorn Aerodrome, about 1.5 miles away.
headcorn.walk: Headcorn Aerodrome is about 1.5 miles from the station. Taxis are available from the station, and I would book one ahead on show days. The number 12 bus also runs from the station to the Aerodrome stop. If you would rather walk, allow about 30 minutes through the village and out to the aerodrome.
headcorn.back: Allow a good half hour to walk back to the station, or book your taxi back before the flying finishes, as everyone wants one at the same time.
headcorn.facNote: When I last checked, in November 2026. Lifts and toilets can be out of order, so check on the day.

shuttleworth.name: Biggleswade
shuttleworth.lead: The nearest station to Shuttleworth, about 3 miles from Old Warden.
rows: Shuttle bus or a 10 minute taxi
shuttleworth.walk: Shuttleworth is about 3 miles from the station. Shuttleworth runs its own shuttle bus from the station on show days, which you book with your show tickets. A taxi from the rank near the station takes about 10 minutes, and I would book one ahead on show days.
shuttleworth.back: Catch the shuttle bus back at the time you booked, or book your taxi back before the day, as local firms get busy when the flying finishes.
shuttleworth.facNote: When I last checked, in November 2026. Lifts and toilets can be out of order, so check on the day.
